notes: Slayer as host rules: game modes (Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch and modes other Add-Ons add, such as Capture the Flag), lives, points and time to win, rounds that end with the winner announced and reset after the time between rounds, the pre-round countdown with its voice and buzzer and players frozen in place, and teams that sort, balance and spawn on their own team spawns, with friendly fire off by default and team chat. Capture points (the 8x8 and 16x16 Capture Point bricks) fill a bar for a team standing on them, ease back when they leave, and turn to the capturing team's colour, with points for the capture and the onCPCapture, onCPCapture(TeamN) and onCPReset brick events. Players out of lives spectate five seconds after their last death: orbiting the living players and the capture points (fire and jet step through them), a free camera, or the auto camera gliding past each player at a wide angle, with jump or the light key changing the mode and Team-Only DeadCam, Enable Auto-Camera Mode and Spectate Capture Points in the settings. The fly-through camera works too: /createFlyCam, /setKnot, /setJump, /testFlyCam and /deleteFlyCam lay and try a path that flies every member before the round (Play At Beginning of Round, Countdown During Fly-Thru, Rounds Between Fly-Thrus). Its settings are in the Mini-Game window's Add-On Settings, beside the vanilla mini-game settings Slayer also edited; /teams and /slayer work as in Slayer. Builders' wrench has Slayer's event outputs: setTeamControl (a team spawn or capture point to a team's colour), setTeamControlLocked (lock a brick, such as a capture point or another mode's flag, for the team that set it off, a colour or everyone), addLives, addKills, addDeaths and their set forms, joinTeam, incTimeRemaining, setTimeRemaining, Win (the player, their team, a named player or team, any text, or nobody), StartFlyThrough (the mini-game's creator), and checkTeam and checkTeamCount with onTeamCheckTrue and onTeamCheckFalse (a row range like "1 4" limits which rows run), and Slayer counts kills and deaths (Clear Stats on Reset). Rows can aim at Team(Client), whoever set the row off's team, and Team(Brick), the teams of the colour holding the brick, to message (ChatMsgAll, CenterPrintAll, BottomPrintAll, with %1 as the player's name), respawn (RespawnAll) or score (IncScore, the team's own points toward the points to win) the whole team. A player on a team also sets off onPlayerTouch(TeamN) and onActivate(TeamN) for their team's place in the list, and every brick of the game hears onMinigameDeath (the client who died, with Player(Killer) and Client(Killer)), onMinigameJoin, onMinigameLeave, onMinigameRoundStart and onMinigameRoundEnd. With Restrict Output Events on (Events in the settings), a player in the game adds Slayer's mini-game and team outputs only if they may edit the game, and the copy's admin-only ones only as an admin; a refused row is left out and they are told why. Each team dresses its members by its Uniform (None, Shirt Only in the team's colour, Full: a cop hat and plain clothes in the team's colour with a random skin colour, or Custom, the team's Uniform settings part by part with TEAMCOLOR for its colour; Allow Custom Face Decals keeps players' own faces) and gives them its Playertype, Start Equip 0 to 4 (unless Sync w/ Minigame Loadout keeps the game's), Player Scale and Respawn Time; changes reach players at once, a new start tool only where they still carry the old one. A round ends with the End of Round Report: teams and players with their score, kills and deaths, and VICTORY or DEFEAT, as its settings say; players can hide it in Options. With the Blockhead Bot Add-On on, a team's Preferred Player Count (Bots in its settings) fills it with bots named Bot and a first name: they join as members, wear the team's uniform with a random skin colour, carry its start tools with one in hand, roam and fight, rest during the countdown and between rounds, respawn after the Bot respawn time, and leave as players join the team, return as they go, and leave with the teams or the game. Killing one is worth Kill Bot instead of Kill Player, Bot under Damage decides whether spawn-brick bots in the game hurt anyone, and /teams listmembers counts them. Without the Add-On the count goes back to -1 and whoever runs the game is told. (Slayer's objectives, rally nodes and team bot holes are not used by anything in 4.1.5.) Saving a build keeps the mini-game its saver runs, with its settings, teams and fly-through path (Slayer's saved configs and their .pathcam); loading the build sets them up again in the loader's game, or a new one of theirs, and resets it, as loading a config did. Team swaps (/teams join, /acceptSwap), /teams living and addLives, balancing and shuffling, spectator teams, Late Join Time, Reset When Empty, Default Minigame, Color, Name Distance, Clear Scores, Use Spawn Bricks and Spawn Brick Color, and the lines announcing each changed setting work as in Slayer; its server-wide settings (Create Minigame Rights, Max Teams, Auto Start, Save Settings on Update) are in the host's Admin menu, under Add-On Settings. Team captains are not ported: Slayer 4.1.5 never makes anyone captain, so its captain settings do nothing there either. Slayer's bricks say whose they are as they are planted or repainted ("Team Spawn Point set for Red."); two or more Region Boundary bricks in a game's colour fence its bricks in; a brick named Team_<colour> or TeamVehicle_<colour> is held by that colour's teams; Team Vehicle Spawns keep other teams off their vehicles; the paint can on a capture point makes its new colour the one it goes back to; bricks knocked out by events come back on reset, and the game's own resets say so. Path and Rally nodes planted by hand go out of sight and out of the way, as Slayer hid them for its bots' paths. Team Bot Holes come from the Bot_Hole Add-On's bot holes, which are not ported. Slayer_setPref is left out: Slayer registers it only when the host adds an .advancedEvents.txt file, and warns it is insecure. Not ported yet: uniforms on player types with their own model (Slayer tints the whole body in the team's colour).
